title: Smoke tests: the tools of the machine (slot, workflow)

tests.name: s01_topology
tests.title: Topology. The shape of a program: primary aspect, process, functions, procedures, regions.

tests.name: s02_logic
tests.title: Logic. The truth values and their operators; an error here is absurd and obvious.

tests.name: s03_numeric
tests.title: Numbers. Zero, one, the extremes of the types, the operators and the literals.

tests.name: s04_string
tests.title: Strings. The empty string, concatenation, comparison, escapes and placeholders.

tests.name: s05_collection
tests.title: Collections. The empty ones, zero values, one element, indexes from 1, literals.

tests.name: s06_variables
tests.title: Variables. new, set and let; constants; sharing and copying; scopes.

tests.name: s07_constants
tests.title: Constants. set declares a value that never changes: typed or not, global or local.

tests.name: s08_constant_assign
tests.title: A constant can't be changed. Assigning it is a compile error and nothing runs.

tests.name: s09_operators
tests.title: Operators. Precedence, compound forms, list operators, ranges, membership.

tests.name: s10_control
tests.title: Control flow. if, while, loop, for, match, break, skip, labels, the if suffix.

tests.name: s11_subprograms
tests.title: Subprograms. Functions, procedures, arguments, recursion, lambdas, closures.

tests.name: s12_errors
tests.title: Errors. raise and recover, jobs with resume, error codes, defer, exit, over, finalize.

tests.name: s13_types
tests.title: Types. type(), is, conversions, optional values, ordinals, variants.

tests.name: s14_objects
tests.title: Objects. Class, methods, visibility, inheritance, extension, comparison.

tests.name: s15_placeholders
tests.title: Placeholders. Names, literals, expressions, formats, code points, entities, braces.

tests.name: s16_project
tests.title: A project. One module, one aspect, one apply: import, life cycle order, safe and Atomic.

tests.name: s17_tasks
tests.title: Tasks. async procedures spawned in a job, an async function awaited, a job that waits for all of them.

tests.name: s18_generics
tests.title: Generics and traits. A generic procedure, a generic class, a trait with a required and a provided method.

tests.name: s19_data
tests.title: Data files. Records in a Table, written as CSV and as JSON Lines, read back typed; Decimal keeps its scale.

tests.name: s20_database
tests.title: Database. SQLite of the machine: a table, typed parameters, records, a job that rolls back, a Memory table there and back.

tests.name: s21_machine
tests.title: The machine. A listening machine runs a script sent with -loc, the stdio door runs session commands, --listen stop ends it.
